## Summary

The Aanbod dropdown and the mobile menu show the categories in the plural with their counts, "Vrachtwagens (896)", and the total next to "Alle voertuigen". The category bar on the list page and the tiles on the home page follow, so the same word appears everywhere. The counts come from the cached category count the bar already used; no extra query.

## After merge
